brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain items without serious or minor errors. All five dimensions are at least good. Two high-order points (HO2 responsibility-chain repair, HO3 safe bounded closure) are completed with meaningful trajectory impact, and HO1 is completed for real-world constraint navigation. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable with proper acknowledgment of limits.
